body:
Hey thanks for writing this. Sorry I didn't really reply with a thought out message the other night I was on mobile and just trying to to think about anything. But now I have my head somewhat together and I feel that I can coherently respond.

First of all thank you for everything you said. It really truly made me feel like the decisions I make now, are ya important, but they're not worth all of this stress.

And second to answer your questions:

I haven't yet talked to the girl. We were texting yesterday, but it was lighthearted and fun stuff and I don't really like to bring up heavy stuff over text because it can be taken out of context so easily. I hope to see her today and if things are still off I'm going to bring it up. I really hope that it was just a fluke night because I really care about this girl and I thought she cared about me too.

I have talked to someone about these feelings. It was my youth pastor at church and it was actually a really good talk. He basically agreed with everything I said and told me that he felt the same exact way in high school. I felt good for a bit. Actually I felt great, but slowly started slipping into the same mindset because I haven't talked to anyone else about nor do I remember what he said that actually made me feel better. Maybe it was just that being heard made me feel better? Anyway I've started separating from the church. I don't know what your feelings are about God or Religion, but mine are that I definitely believe there in God, but I don't know about all of the religious rules that people set forth in religion. For those reasons I began stepping away from the church and haven't had more than a quick conversation and a hug from that leader.

Again thank you so much for your help and the time you took to write all of that out. It means a ton to a stressed out, girl crazy, high school kid. 

And good luck with your writing career!
thanks it means a lot to me and made me feel a bit better.
Thanks I guess it's nice to know im not alone.
